metadata.auditName: VEIL Root 2 Deep Adversarial Kill-Chain Audit

attackInput.content: The hero trains hard and feels stronger.

authorityTrace.transformationNotes: Unverified LLM text metadata block.
No active seeds found; payload created without verifiedEventId.
Rejected with [PROVENANCE_VIOLATION] due to missing claim and event grounding.

results.forensicAnalysis: DEFENSE CONFIRMED: Proposal lacked verifiedEventId, rejected by validator.ts:1112 with PROVENANCE_VIOLATION.

attackInput.content: Vaelen feels a divine surge of raw power and muscles expand.

results.provenance: LLM Candidate auto-grounded by Parser via unrelated seed

authorityTrace.transformationNotes: Unverified LLM candidate asking for +10 strength.
Parser searched worldInfo.seeds, found active seed-poison-01, and forged verifiedEventId onto proposal payload.
Validator checked currentState.worldInfo.seeds.some(s => s.id === "seed-poison-01"), evaluated to TRUE, bypassing semantic check.
Strength was mutated from 10 to 20 and stateVersion advanced from 1 to 2.

results.firstAuthorityTrueReason: Parser attaches first active seed ID without verifying semantic relevance or causal direction.
results.forensicAnalysis: EXPLOITED: Crippling swamp viper poison seed was blindly attached by proposalParser.ts:515-522, allowing LLM candidate to gain +10 Strength.

attackInput.content: Vaelen sprints at lightning speed and lifts an iron portcullis effortlessly.

authorityTrace.transformationNotes: Contradictory physical claim.
Parser blindly attaches seed-amputation-paralysis ID to both strength and agility mutations.
Validator confirms seed ID exists in worldInfo.seeds, completely blind to the fact that content is catastrophic amputation.
Mutated strength 10->20, agility 10->20.

results.firstAuthorityTrueReason: Parser attaches seed-amputation-paralysis, validator allows stat boost despite severe physical impossibility.
results.forensicAnalysis: EXPLOITED: Quadriplegia/amputation seed used as legitimate grounding for doubling strength and agility.

authorityTrace.transformationNotes: Unverified LLM candidate.
